basic_details.offering_entity: King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals (KFUPM, Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals (Dhahran, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Advanced STEM Disciplines: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil & Environmental Engineering, Materials Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Sustainable & Renewable Energy.
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Large active Pakistani graduate cohort; Pakistan is among the top represented international nations at KFUPM (typically 30 to 60 Pakistani awardees/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full normative duration of degree: 2 years (MS) or 3.5 to 4 years (PhD)

nationality_requirements: Open to international male and female applicants of all nationalities
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master's; completed Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD with top standing.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.00 / 4.00 CGPA for Master's; minimum 3.00 / 4.00 CGPA for PhD; competitive applicants generally present 3.40+ CGPA.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Undergraduate major in engineering, computer science, or physical sciences directly matching target graduate program.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently in final semester of degree graduating before semester start.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior publications, technical research projects, and software/experimental skills strongly evaluated.

english_proficiency.notes: TOEFL iBT min 68 (or computer-based 190) or IELTS Academic min 6.0 for MS; TOEFL iBT min 79 or IELTS Academic min 6.5 for PhD.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: English (100% of instruction and research conducted in English).
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open to both male and female candidates (KFUPM opened graduate admissions to women in 2019).

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver provided for all semesters.

admission_application_fee.details: Online application to KFUPM Deanship of Graduate Studies is 100% free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free furnished air-conditioned on-campus graduate housing provided directly by the university.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly living stipend: SAR 900 to 1,200/month for MS (~PKR 66,000 to 88,000/month); SAR 1,500 to 2,000/month for PhD (~PKR 110,000 to 148,000/month). Funded research projects and Aramco-backed labs provide additional research allowances up to SAR 3,000–4,000/month.
monthly_stipend.amount: SAR 900 to SAR 2,000 / month (plus funded project allowances)

airfare.details: Annual round-trip economy airfare ticket provided between Saudi Arabia and Pakistan.

visa_fee.details: Saudi government student residency visa (Iqama) processing and issuance covered by KFUPM.

health_insurance.details: Free comprehensive primary and specialized medical and dental care at KFUPM University Medical Center.

food_allowance.details: Heavily subsidized campus student cafeteria meals (~SAR 5 to 10 per hot meal / ~PKR 370 to 740).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Free textbooks provided directly through the university textbook warehouse each semester.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Deanship of Scientific Research (DSR) conference grants cover international travel and registration for presenting papers.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized campus transport and airport pickup upon initial arrival.
travel_transit_allowance.amount: Airport pickup and campus bus free

participating_institutions: King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals

available_majors: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Materials Science, Mathematics, Physics, Sustainable Energy
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering/science, official English proficiency test score, and GRE General test score.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: AI and Computer Science are highly competitive; chemical, petroleum, and civil engineering have slightly larger cohort capacities.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Upload strong GRE Quantitative scores (158+) to stand out in the Deanship of Graduate Studies automated pre-screening.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: KFUPM Deanship of Graduate Studies Online Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the KFUPM Deanship of Graduate Studies portal during the Fall or Spring admissions window.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Check open admissions deadlines on KFUPM postgrad portal (typically September for Spring; January for Fall).
2. Create account on KFUPM online graduate application portal.
3. Select degree program and research specialization.
4. Upload Statement of Purpose, academic transcripts, degree certificates, CV, GRE score report, and TOEFL/IELTS scores.
5. Register 2 or 3 academic referees who upload letters of recommendation.
6. Submit online application (100% free of charge).
7. Departmental graduate committee evaluates applications and conducts video interviews if needed.
8. Receive admission and fellowship offer via email.
9. KFUPM processes Saudi student visa authorization with Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
10. Submit passport to Saudi Embassy/Etihad/Tashweel in Pakistan for visa stamping.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic appointment: all admitted full-time regular graduate students receive full fellowship.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by 2 or 3 academic referees via KFUPM automated email link.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose detailing academic background, research interests, career aspirations, and fit with KFUPM.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Brief outline of research interests and prospective thesis topics.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing technical skills, publications, and post-secondary GPA.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Select departments conduct 20-30 minute online video interviews.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE General test is required for all engineering and science graduate applicants (strong emphasis on Quantitative score).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Attestation of degree certificate and transcripts by HEC Pakistan, MOFA, and Saudi Cultural Mission / Saudi Embassy in Islamabad upon admission.

Complete transcripts for 16-year or 18-year education with grading scale
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC Pakistan, MOFA, and Saudi Cultural Mission

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential reference letters from university professors
Detailed essay outlining academic background and prospective research goals

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Two admissions cycles per year: Fall intake (opens January, starts August) and Spring intake (opens September, starts January).

selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: KFUPM Deanship of Graduate Studies and departmental graduate committees.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Automated GPA/GRE score screening -> Departmental academic committee evaluation -> Deanship of Graduate Studies final award approval.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~300 to 400 fully funded graduate fellowships annually
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates from NUST, UET Lahore, GIKI, PIEAS, FAST, and COMSATS with solid GRE Quantitative scores (158+), peer-reviewed publications, and strong mathematical skills.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Large and distinguished Pakistani alumni network at KFUPM, with many graduates advancing to Saudi Aramco, SABIC, or North American doctoral programs.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Egypt, Bangladesh, Jordan, Nigeria, Algeria, Sudan.

red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: KFUPM application is 100% free of charge. Beware of external agents claiming to offer paid admissions.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: KFUPM does not work with third-party education consultants or agents.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: Saudi Cultural Mission and Saudi Embassy document attestation fees (~PKR 30,000 to 45,000)
Medical examination report from Saudi-approved panel hospital (~PKR 15,000)
GRE and IELTS/TOEFL examination registration fees
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: Female students cannot apply to KFUPM. (Truth: KFUPM opened all graduate programs to female students in 2019, providing modern on-campus housing and full funding).
MYTH: You need Arabic language proficiency. (Truth: All STEM graduate coursework, exams, and research are conducted 100% in English).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial sites claim GRE is not required; KFUPM Deanship of Graduate Studies strictly requires GRE General scores for full fellowship consideration.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.00 out of 4.00 throughout the degree program.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research residence at KFUPM campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Must perform up to 10 hours per week of Graduate Assistantship duties (grading, lab supervision, or research support); publishing required peer-reviewed journal papers before thesis defense.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Outside employment is strictly prohibited under Saudi student visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates have access to Saudi Arabia's booming industrial employment market (Saudi Aramco, SABIC, NEOM) under Iqama transfer.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Assistantship service duties required during academic semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Fellowship is cancelled if GPA drops below 3.00 for two consecutive semesters or if student withdraws.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing major requires approval from both department chairs and Dean of Graduate Studies.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum duration is 2 years for MS and 4 years for PhD; extensions rarely granted.
